title: Harden Linux systemd unit ownership checks against parent-directory substitution.
changes: Pin every parent component of a Linux systemd unit path through O_DIRECTORY / O_NOFOLLOW and descriptor-relative opens before trusting its launcher or inode.
Reject swapped symlink parents, nonregular/oversized unit files, changed inode metadata and unrecognized ExecStart values; keep reads bounded to 64 KiB and fail closed before uninstallation.
Add a regression which demonstrates that a parent symlink replacement was accepted by the prior code and is rejected by this version. Preserve PID-1 and user service lifecycle checks.

Preserve v0.2.256 macOS LaunchAgent recovery, paired-device credentials, the DLL-free source-only Windows profile and opt-in WebRTC consent/E2EE boundaries. No additional native binary, automatic screen access or control permission is included.
